assumptions.basis: standard ceiling: legal minimum 2.40 m plus build-up

brief.notes:
Design a simple single-story 3-bedroom house for a small family.

Include a living room, kitchen, dining area, two bathrooms, and three bedrooms. Make the layout practical, with good natural light and easy movement between the rooms.

Keep the overall design simple and compact.
